nodes.body: **Inherited tool paths disappear** `hook-env --json` never saves `__MISE_ORIG_PATH`, but the reused PATH code needs it to protect inherited entries. If the editor already has a selected tool's bin directory on `PATH`, the first call leaves it alone but records it in `__MISE_DIFF.path`. After the editor applies the response and leaves that project, `get_pristine_env` removes that inherited directory. Commands from it can then stop working. Return `__MISE_ORIG_PATH` on the first JSON call, or track only paths this mode actually added. **Knowledge Base Used:** [Environment and shell integration](https://app.greptile.com/jdx-org/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/jdx/mise/-/docs/environment-and-shell-integration.md)

**Hook skip rule is misleading** Hooks with a `shell` key can still run. For example, `enter = { run = "echo setup", shell = "bash -c" }` runs because `matches_shell` skips only `CurrentShell` hooks; `Run` hooks use their own shell. Plugin authors following this page may trigger commands they expect to be skipped. Say that current-shell `script`/`scripts` hooks are skipped, while spawned `run` and task hooks still execute. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!

**Shell calls receive JSON** `json_requested` checks whether `--json` appears anywhere, but a later `--shell` overrides it. With an unchanged session, `mise hook-env --json --shell bash` therefore prints JSON instead of the selected shell output. A shell that evaluates this response gets syntax errors. Honor the last output flag, or skip the fast path when both flags appear. **Knowledge Base Used:** [CLI and command execution](https://app.greptile.com/jdx-org/-/custom-context/knowledge-base/jdx/mise/-/docs/cli-and-command-execution.md)

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Do not treat option values as short flags.** For `mise hook-env -EJava`, `J` is part of the `-E` value, not `-J`. On an unchanged fast-path run, this check selects JSON output for a shell-mode command, so evaluating the output fails. Parse short-option groups with their value-taking options, or decline the fast path when the group is ambiguous. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jdx/mise/cfe6fdc4ab028fc43c8a94e52c1c2e541ed71d02/src/cli/mod.rs))
